audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page states that Mel's Rebuttal (W) reflects projectiles back at the attacker, and Vayne's Condemn (E) is flagged as a projectile.
audit.why: Riot text: Rebuttal 'forms a barrier around herself that reflects enemy projectiles back at the attacker, prevents her from taking damage'. Condemn's kit flag is 'projectile'. This is the single decisive interaction in the matchup and it never reaches the page.
audit.corrected: Rebuttal (W) reflects Condemn (E) and blanks the damage entirely; it is on 38/35/33/29/26s, so bait it and Condemn after.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[2] is titled 'Waste Condemn with no wall' but its description is the tumble-into-engage text; dontsFull[1] 'Fight in melee range' carries an unrelated cooldown line.
audit.why: Copy-paste defect — two Don'ts render descriptions that do not match their headings.
audit.corrected: Condemn only stuns into terrain, and Rebuttal (W) reflects the bolt; Mel's range advantage is 950 (Q) / 1000 (E).

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gives Vayne levels 2, 3 and first item; the audited Mel-side chart reads Mel, Mel, Mel, Skill, Skill, Skill, Vayne.
audit.why: Mel pokes from 950 (Radiant Volley) and roots from 1000 (Solar Snare) against a 550-range melee-pattern Vayne; she owns levels 1-3. The two directions must agree or mirror-fix overwrites this page.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-2 to Mel, row 5 to Skill, keeping rows 3, 4 Skill and row 6 Vayne, proposed as a matched full/content group.

audit.why: Spikes read Lvl 3-5, Lvl 6, 1st item, Late with four entries present, and the Blade of the Ruined King / Final Hour scaling story matches the 55.28% win rate over 814 games.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown block names no numbers at all.
audit.why: Solar Snare is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s, Rebuttal 38/35/33/29/26s, Golden Eclipse 120/100/80s, Final Hour 100/85/70s. Concrete numbers are what make the advice actionable.

edits.before: - Mel Solar Snare: matchup-defining — Her root / slow zone — sets up her combo. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Solar Snare: 9s at rank 5 — matchup-defining root, dodge it and Golden Eclipse cannot finish you. - Rebuttal: 38s at rank 1, and it reflects Condemn — bait it first, then fire. - Final Hour: 100s — kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Mel's Solar Snare: Her root / slow zone — sets up her combo. Dodge it. When it is down — Condemn + silver-bolt shred.
edits.after: Solar Snare roots at 1000 range and sets her combo; Rebuttal (W) reflects Condemn, so bait the 38s W first, then Condemn into a wall.

notes: Every full-layer string on this page refers to Mel as 'he'/'his'; Mel is female. Too many strings to rewrite inside the length band without churn — flagging for a scripted pronoun pass. Also: Silver Bolts procs on the third consecutive attack OR ability on the same target, so Condemn counts as one of the three (from mirror findings), and Tumble grants invisibility only while Final Hour is active — the current text does not misstate this, but nearby champions did.
